HeroSection.subtitle: GmSportStudio puts pro-grade analysis on your laptop. Unlimited button board, multiple games per project and clip cutting in seconds — at a price any coach can afford.

WhySection.subtitle: The same level of analysis professional teams use, with plans designed for individual coaches and clubs at every level.

youtube.title: Your tagging system, with no limits
youtube.body: Every coach analyzes differently. Build as many categories and subcategories as you need — defensive, offensive, transition, set plays, dead-ball plays — and reuse them across any project. Your button board follows you from game to game.

dashboard.title: All your data at a glance
dashboard.body: A single panel that brings together players, sessions, clips and stats. Filter by game, player or tactical action. Present your reports straight from the app — no exports required.

price.title: Elite tech for modest clubs
price.body: Pro-grade analysis software has historically been out of reach for most clubs. GmSportStudio breaks that barrier with monthly plans, yearly plans and team license packs — without cutting a single feature.

faqs.q0: When do I get access after subscribing?
faqs.a0: Immediately. After paying through Gumroad, you'll receive an email with your license and download link. The app is available for macOS (Apple Silicon and Intel) and Windows 10/11. You can start using it the same day and cancel anytime.
faqs.q1: Do I need an external video subscription?
faqs.a1: No. Work directly with your own video files (MP4, MOV, MKV, AVI). You can group multiple games into a single project and reuse your button board across them. If you want to use YouTube videos, download them first with any external tool and open them as local files.
faqs.q2: Does it work on Mac and PC?
faqs.a2: Yes. The app runs on macOS (Apple Silicon and Intel) and Windows 10/11. The installer adapts automatically to your platform.
faqs.a3: Three options. For individual coaches: Monthly plan at €14.99/mo or Annual plan at €99/yr (45% savings vs monthly). For clubs and academies: Club plan with 5 seats at €299/yr, ideal for the entire coaching staff to share clips library and scouting. Federations or clubs with more than 5 coaches: email clubes@gmsportstudio.com for a custom quote.
